say:0:1660210001:2.text: Past a grove of towering palms, a Mauler tribe comes into view.
say:0:1660210001:2.source_cn: 你和柳博米尔顺着声音的方向走过去，绕过高大的棕榈树林，...
say:0:1660210001:2.male: Past a grove of towering palms, a Mauler tribe comes into view.
say:0:1660210001:2.female: Past a grove of towering palms, a Mauler tribe comes into view.

say:2:1660210002:1.text: Lively music spills out from the tribe. People move busily through the camp. A celebration's clearly underway.
say:2:1660210002:1.source_cn: 一阵阵热烈的音乐从部落中传出来，部落中人来人往，气氛热...

say:4:1660210003:1.text: You suggest checking it out. Maybe the one creating these dreams is here.
say:4:1660210003:1.source_cn: 你提议应该进去看看，生成梦境的人说不定就在这个部落里。
say:4:1660210003:1.male: You suggest checking it out. Maybe the one creating these dreams is here.
say:4:1660210003:1.female: You suggest checking it out. Maybe the one creating these dreams is here.

say:6:1660210004:0.text: I'm not one for crowds. But if you're going, I'm coming too.
say:6:1660210004:0.source_cn: 跻身这嘈杂的人群并非我所愿，但既然你如此要求，我很愿意相陪。
say:6:1660210004:0.male: I'm not one for crowds. But if you're going, I'm coming too.
say:6:1660210004:0.female: I'm not one for crowds. But if you're going, I'm coming too.

choice_prompt:7:1660210004.text: I'm not one for crowds. But if you're going, I'm coming too.
choice_prompt:7:1660210004.source_cn: 跻身这嘈杂的人群并非我所愿，但既然你如此要求，我很愿意相陪。
choice_prompt:7:1660210004.male: I'm not one for crowds. But if you're going, I'm coming too.
choice_prompt:7:1660210004.female: I'm not one for crowds. But if you're going, I'm coming too.

say:8:1660210005:0.text: The heat, the noise, the smell... It's been a long time since I've felt all this... This dream is too real for comfort.
say:8:1660210005:0.source_cn: 唉，人群带来的热浪，复杂的气味，这些都是我许久未曾感受...
say:8:1660210005:0.male: The heat, the noise, the smell... It's been a long time since I've felt all this... This dream is too real for comfort.
say:8:1660210005:0.female: The heat, the noise, the smell... It's been a long time since I've felt all this... This dream is too real for comfort.

say:9:1660210006:1.text: You chat as you make your way toward the nearest gate.
say:9:1660210006:1.source_cn: 你们一边闲谈，一边向着最近的一座大门走去。
say:9:1660210006:1.male: You chat as you make your way toward the nearest gate.
say:9:1660210006:1.female: You chat as you make your way toward the nearest gate.

say:10:1660210007:1.text: But just before you reach it, several tall, broad-shouldered Maulers block your path.
say:10:1660210007:1.source_cn: 可到达门前你们才发现，大门被几个高大健壮的蛮血把守着，...
say:10:1660210007:1.male: But just before you reach it, several tall, broad-shouldered Maulers block your path.
say:10:1660210007:1.female: But just before you reach it, several tall, broad-shouldered Maulers block your path.

say:14:1660210010:0.text: Turn back. The <style="highlight">summer curse</style> is spreading. Outsiders aren't welcome here.

choice_prompt:15:1660210010.text: Turn back. The <style="highlight">summer curse</style> is spreading. Outsiders aren't welcome here.
choice_prompt:15:1660210010.source_cn: 请回，最近<style=highlight>夏日诅咒</style>盛行，夏日部落不欢迎外来者。

say:16:1660210011:0.text: Ah, so you're a fashion critic? Please, enlighten me on tribal couture.
say:16:1660210011:0.source_cn: 您对夏日部落的传统服饰有何见解？我洗耳恭听。

say:17:1660210013:0.text: What exactly is the summer curse?

say:18:1660210014:0.text: Bryon eyes you both, skeptical at first. But your blank looks must convince him, and he starts to explain.
say:18:1660210014:0.source_cn: 布莱恩有些怀疑地打量了你们一阵，见你们似乎真的一无所知...
say:18:1660210014:0.male: Bryon eyes you both, skeptical at first. But your blank looks must convince him, and he starts to explain.
say:18:1660210014:0.female: Bryon eyes you both, skeptical at first. But your blank looks must convince him, and he starts to explain.

say:19:1660210015:0.text: The summer curse twists the mind. People turn on their loved ones, lash out at everything and everyone they see.
say:19:1660210015:0.source_cn: 夏日诅咒是一种可怕的癔症，染上诅咒之人会六亲不认，仇恨...

say:20:1660210016:0.text: Last month, the neighboring tribe caught it. One day, they were tending their fields... the next, it was a bloodbath.
say:20:1660210016:0.source_cn: 据我所知，就在上个月，烈阳部落染上了夏日诅咒，原本丰饶...

say:21:1660210017:0.text: So if you value your lives, best turn around. Our gates are shut to all outsiders for now.
say:21:1660210017:0.source_cn: 为了诸位的性命着想，你们还是快点离开吧，现在部落不会接...

say:22:1660210018:0.text: You and Ludovic exchange a look. Before you can say anything else, a commotion erupts in the distance.
say:22:1660210018:0.source_cn: 你和柳博米尔对视一眼，还不等你们继续尝试沟通，更远处突...
say:22:1660210018:0.male: You and Ludovic exchange a look. Before you can say anything else, a commotion erupts in the distance.
say:22:1660210018:0.female: You and Ludovic exchange a look. Before you can say anything else, a commotion erupts in the distance.

say:23:1660210019:0.text: A burly Mauler rushes over and whispers to Bryon. His expression hardens, and he heads straight for the noise.
say:23:1660210019:0.source_cn: 一个强壮的蛮血快步赶来，对着布莱恩耳语几句。布莱恩的神...

say:24:1660210020:0.text: You and Ludovic nod to each other and silently follow his lead.
say:24:1660210020:0.source_cn: 你和柳博米尔对视一眼，默契地跟上了布莱恩的脚步。
say:24:1660210020:0.male: You and Ludovic nod to each other and silently follow his lead.
say:24:1660210020:0.female: You and Ludovic nod to each other and silently follow his lead.

choice:15:1:2.text: So... spring gives way to summer, huh?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 你什么时候加入部落了？
choice:15:1:2.male: So... spring gives way to summer, huh?
choice:15:1:2.female: So... spring gives way to summer, huh?

say:26:1660210012:0.text: Join? I never left. I've always been the Summer Tribe's priest.
say:26:1660210012:0.source_cn: ……加入？我本就是夏日部落的祭祀，从未脱离。

choice:15:2:3.text: When did you join the tribe?
choice:15:2:3.male: When did you join the tribe?
choice:15:2:3.female: When did you join the tribe?

say:27:1660210009:0.text: Strange... I don't recall ever meeting you.
say:27:1660210009:0.source_cn: 怪事，我不记得与您有过会晤。

choice:13:1:2.text: Bryon, you too? What are you doing here?
choice:13:1:2.male: Bryon, you too? What are you doing here?
choice:13:1:2.female: Bryon, you too? What are you doing here?

choice:7:0:1.text: It's just a dream. Nothing to lose.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 想开点儿，这一切都是梦
choice:7:0:1.male: It's just a dream. Nothing to lose.
choice:7:0:1.female: It's just a dream. Nothing to lose.
